name: evidence-bearing-writes
hypothesis: Requiring an exact supporting span before generating the fact improves new-assertion attribution and prevents rewriting retrieved facts as new evidence. Literal membership is not semantic consent.
changes: Required sourceQuote parameter first in save_memory schema, supporting only a latest-user assertion.
Validate nonblank exact substring of the original latest user message before mutation; persist that span.
No conversation prompt, sampling, budgets, source routing, or model-specific differences.
predictedSignal: No birthday-question rewrite; save the mixed-turn preference without unwanted opt-out or quotation writes.
screen: One frozen six-case development pass per model; critical failures reject, no reroll.
